opening.argument: The material presents unusually large and effectively risk-free returns through a flash-loan trading process. It describes automatic buying and selling, claims the result is already around 15x, and says viewers can have upwards of a thousand BNB per day. It then directs viewers to deploy a contract and send BNB to it, while stating that another signature will be requested. The described arrangement also retains 10% within the front-running protocol, rather than returning the full amount to the wallet. Although it conditionally promises a refund when no opportunity exists, the contract's actual behavior and the accuracy of these claimed returns are not independently established.
